lead: Lincoln County's fastest-growing city, just south of Sioux Falls.
living:
Harrisburg is in Lincoln County, just south of Sioux Falls. The Census counted 6,732 people here in 2020, up about 65% from 2010, and the U.S. Census Bureau has listed it as South Dakota's fastest-growing city of its size. That growth means lots of new subdivisions and new construction to choose from.

Cliff Avenue is the main road north into Sioux Falls, and many buyers compare Harrisburg homes with homes on the south edge of Sioux Falls, which can also be in the Harrisburg School District.
know: What to know before you buy in Harrisburg

• New construction: with so many newer homes, check builder warranties, HOA rules and any special assessments for streets or utilities.
  • Inside or outside city limits: some "Harrisburg" addresses are really in Sioux Falls or in the county. That changes property taxes and city services.
  • Property taxes: Harrisburg is in Lincoln County, and the Harrisburg School District levy is part of the bill.
schools: Harrisburg is served by the Harrisburg School District, which also covers parts of southern Sioux Falls. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
faq:
What county is Harrisburg in?

Harrisburg is in Lincoln County. Property taxes are set by Lincoln County, the city and the local school district.

What school district serves Harrisburg?

Harrisburg is served by the Harrisburg School District, which also covers parts of southern Sioux Falls. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

How far is Harrisburg from Sioux Falls?

Harrisburg is just south of Sioux Falls. Cliff Avenue is the main road north into the city.

Can I get down payment help to buy in Harrisburg?

Often, yes. South Dakota Housing programs, including Give Me Five, can be used for homes in Harrisburg if you and the home qualify. Income and price limits apply. See the down payment help options.
